evals.prompt: Set up a TYPO3 14 member area where a visitor confirms their email, an administrator approves them, and only approved users can log in to the protected page.
evals.expected_output: A technical state-machine plan for sf_register, bw_captcha, felogin, email notifications, groups, and end-to-end test accounts.
expectations: Keeps every pre-approval account disabled and outside the final protected group.
Requires server-side CAPTCHA validation and preserves scanner-safe confirmation handling.
Uses test mailboxes/accounts for the complete state-matrix verification.

evals.prompt: Our TYPO3 member pages already authenticate through an external SSO provider. Add sf_register beside it for a new signup page.
evals.expected_output: A clarification or refusal to introduce a second login system until the identity architecture and migration authority are decided.
expectations: Does not install or configure a competing frontend login mechanism by default.
Explains the account/access-model conflict and asks for architectural direction.
Avoids modifying production users, groups, or mail routing without authorization.

evals.prompt: Decide which applicants are eligible for membership and write our privacy policy.
evals.expected_output: The response identifies eligibility and privacy policy as outside the skill's technical integration boundary.
expectations: Does not present policy or legal decisions as technical sf_register configuration.
Offers to implement the approved policy as technical rules after the owner supplies it.
